institution: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC)
problem_solved: Limited visualization and navigation capabilities during colon reconstruction analysis
description: VIEW is a virtual endoscopy visualization software developed for 3D reconstruction of colon structures from CT imaging data. The platform provides interactive visualization and navigation through reconstructed anatomical models to assist clinical analysis and interpretation.
applications:
Hospitals, diagnostic imaging centers, and gastroenterology departments
Medical imaging and radiology software companies
Medical colleges, teaching hospitals, and clinical research institutions
Healthcare technology firms developing advanced visualization solutions
Organizations implementing virtual diagnostics and computer-assisted clinical analysis systems
